_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. Source is the keyless HN Firebase API (no browser, no proxy), so compute per lead is tiny. First 10 qualified_lead per run are free for validation.

listing.eventDescription: One hiring post with company, role, location, remote flag, and salary, but no apply email or URL.

lead.eventDescription: A hiring post with an apply URL or company website, plus role, location, remote flag, and salary.

qualified_lead.eventDescription: A hiring post with a direct apply email, plus role, location, and salary. A company actively hiring with a reachable contact. The first 10 qualified_lead per run are free so you can validate output.
